scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start -w server
scripts.app:dev: concurrently -k -n server,client,electron -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 tcp:4000 && cross-env POS_DEV=1 electron ."
